newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY MOL TO OPEN HUF 10 BLN GAS STORAGE.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY MOL TO OPEN HUF 10 BLN GAS STORAGE.

text.p: Hungarian oil and gas company Magyar Olaj- es Gazipari Rt (MOL) will open a 600 million cubic meters gas storage capacity on Friday, MOL said on Wednesday.
"Gas storage facilities increase strategic safety and somewhat diminish our exposure, despite growing export needs," the company said in a statement.
The storage facility, built at the former south Hungarian natural gas field of Zsana, could hold some five percent of the country's annual needs, MOL said.
In 1995 Hungary used 11.68 billion cubic meters of natural gas, of which 6.8 billion was imported, mainly from Russia.
The country's existing gas storage facilities (without Zsana) are of 2.02 billion cubic meters capacity.
"Gas storage can eliminate shortages in peak winter months, when daily consumption can be as high as six times that of summer days," MOL said.
MOL's board has decided to start a second Zsana project, which would add another 600 million cubic meters storage capacity by 2000, the company said.
Hungary's natural gas consumption is expected to grow to 15 billion cubic meters per year by 2010, while domestic production would drop to 2.9 billion cubic metres.
On the Budapest Stock Exchange MOL shares finished at 1,570 forints, up 20.
